name: Views Field View Lazy Load
description: Embeds a View inside another View's field, loaded lazily via AJAX.
project_description:
This module allows you to add a View as a field within your View (the same as Views Field View ), but to have it lazy-load; this means you won't put as much strain on your server. It depends on both Views Field View and Views Ajax Lazy Load Blocks .

 How might you use this module? My use-cases have involved bringing in several Views-based Charts (generated from the Charts module ) into a single view; for example, seeing a chart for each term in a vocabulary on one page.
